**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Freeze the normative EDGE requirements document**

After the scope becomes `defined`, a later commit can rewrite the normative prose in `specs/requirements/agent-edge-104.md` while retaining the same headings and pass these gates: this loop compares only the two YAML catalogs with the original manifest, while `validate_edge_indexes` merely verifies that each referenced heading still exists. The approved requirement can therefore change without changing its registered definition, so bind the Markdown bytes or digest in the immutable GZ-022 declaration and verify it here as well.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L23-L25](https://github.com/ElectricDogCN/Guize/blob/4bdfe42532aa5bfa62f879af5f3dedd69c673fc5/AGENTS.md#L23-L25)
